preprocessing: Training-only StandardScaler; no additional runner log1p
split: Two-stage stratified train_test_split(.30 then .50), same seed for both stages
selection: Highest validation Macro-F1, earliest on ties; no patience early stopping
metrics: Original source score including macro P/R/F1, weighted F1, per-class P/R/F1, phishing/scamming AP and confusion cells
memory_execution: Same policy for both datasets: GAT activation recomputation + 32768 edge chunks; X-MoE expert recomputation
input_contract: Dataset-native features with declared names/units/limits; input_dim inferred. No padding or false common-feature equivalence.
statistics: Paired conditional-exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, exact zeros omitted, average ranks for ties; Holm over four Macro-F1 baseline comparisons.
scope: Shared architecture/training/evaluation implementation; BLTE23 versus RQ1-native5 remains an explicit input adaptation. Existing RQ1 outcomes were inspected: supplemental RQ1 analyses are exploratory.
